name: INSERT_RETURNING_STAR
description: INSERT ... RETURNING * emits every column of the inserted row

name: INSERT_RETURNING_SINGLE_COL
description: INSERT ... RETURNING <col> emits only the named column

name: INSERT_RETURNING_EXPR_ALIAS
description: INSERT ... RETURNING with arithmetic expression and alias

name: INSERT_RETURNING_MULTI_COL
description: INSERT ... RETURNING with multiple bare columns

name: INSERT_MULTI_ROW_RETURNING
description: Multi-row INSERT ... RETURNING emits one result row per inserted row

name: INSERT_RETURNING_PRESERVES_INSERT_ORDER
description: RETURNING does not impose an implicit ORDER BY; rows surface in VALUES order

name: UPDATE_RETURNING_BASIC
description: UPDATE ... RETURNING emits the modified row(s)

name: UPDATE_MULTI_ROW_RETURNING
description: UPDATE that touches multiple rows emits multiple RETURNING rows

name: UPDATE_WHERE_RETURNING_FILTERED
description: UPDATE ... WHERE ... RETURNING only emits the rows actually touched

name: DELETE_RETURNING_BASIC
description: DELETE ... RETURNING emits the deleted row's columns

name: DELETE_WHERE_RETURNING_FILTERED
description: DELETE ... WHERE ... RETURNING emits only the deleted rows

name: DELETE_ALL_RETURNING
description: DELETE FROM t RETURNING emits every deleted row and empties the table

name: UPSERT_RETURNING_UPDATE_PATH
description: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ... RETURNING emits the post-update row

name: UPSERT_RETURNING_INSERT_PATH
description: INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE ... RETURNING also emits the freshly inserted row when no conflict occurred

name: RETURNING_WITH_SCALAR_SUBQUERY
description: RETURNING expression can include a scalar subquery against another table

name: INSERT_SELECT_RETURNING
description: INSERT INTO target SELECT FROM source ... RETURNING emits per inserted row

name: WITH_PREFIX_INSERT_SELECT_RETURNING
description: WITH-prefixed INSERT ... SELECT (CTE as rowsource for the SELECT) supports RETURNING
stdin:
.mode list
.headers off
.separator |
.nullvalue NULL
CREATE TABLE t(a INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, b INTEGER);
WITH src(x,y) AS (VALUES(1,10),(2,20))
INSERT INTO t SELECT x, y FROM src RETURNING a, b;

name: RETURNING_ROWID_NO_PK
description: RETURNING rowid for a table without an INTEGER PRIMARY KEY surfaces the implicit rowid

name: RETURNING_COMPUTED_FROM_INSERTED_ROW
description: RETURNING with a computed column derived from the inserted row's values

name: INSERT_DEFAULT_KEY_RETURNING
description: INSERT with omitted INTEGER PRIMARY KEY column: RETURNING reads the assigned rowid

name: UPDATE_WITH_EXPR_RETURNING
description: UPDATE ... RETURNING can include arithmetic expressions over the touched row

name: INSERT_SELECT_RANGE_RETURNING
description: INSERT INTO ... SELECT FROM a multi-row source emits ordered RETURNING rows
